bundle.shortDescription: Keeps NGM Peon and the NGM addon in sync
bundle.longDescription: The desktop app for NGM Peon (ngmpeon.app) and the Nootropic Guild Manager addon for WoW: Forever. When WoW saves NGM's data, it sends NGM Peon what changed in game, and keeps NGM Peon's news ready for the addon.
